items.title: 61529_Maxine Sullivan oral history interview
items.q: I appeared on his show a couple of times while he was on the air.

ctx.x: Right. In 1948, I believe it was they had 'A Night of Stars' in Pittsburgh and they had Lois Deppe with whom Earl Hines used to play and then they had Billy Eckstine and Errol Garner. They had four generations going for them. Earl had just become popular. Errol Garner. (Deletion)

Well, getting back to the Savoy Sultans with Panama Frances they made their debut down at Highlights in Jazz with Jack Klein singer (phonetic spelling) and I hadn't heard a band for so long and they sounded so good, of course they had nine pieces and you were saying that they didn't have some of the original --
